reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing isSkippedByMonthActions predicate that every month-wide action uses, but parses the tag with its own regex instead of the shared tag parsing in #shared/tags (extractTagsFromText), which defines how tags are delimited and escaped.

duplication.why: The rule exists once; the notes join is repeated in the two queries that feed the predicate, following the tree's existing two-query structure.

placement.why: The skip rule sits in the month-action selection predicate in budget/actions.ts; tag recognition belongs in shared/tags.ts rather than a private regex in the budget module.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the two feeding queries, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: One predicate owns the rule and both data sources supply group notes; the private tag regex can drift from how the rest of the app recognises tags.

bypasses_abstraction.where: hasFixedTag in budget/actions.ts matches '#fixed' with its own regex instead of using the tag parsing helpers in packages/loot-core/src/shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: No existing logic is copied; the regex is a new, different definition of tag matching rather than a reshaped copy.

one_place.where: isSkippedByMonthActions in budget/actions.ts (via hasFixedTag), used by copyPreviousMonth through getBudgetData and by every other month-wide action through getMonthActionCategories; both queries now supply group_notes.
